title: For each year between 2015 and 2018, identify the driver with the fastest Q
question: For each year between 2015 and 2018, identify the driver with the fastest Q2 qualifying time in the Spanish Grand Prix. Return their full name, nationality, and the corresponding year, ordered by year.

prediction.sql:
WITH q2_qualified AS (
    SELECT
        r.XCL_066 AS year,
        q.XCL_058 AS driver_id,
        q.XCL_063 AS q2_time
    FROM qualifying AS q
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
      AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2015 AND 2018
      AND q.XCL_063 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        driver_id,
        q2_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY q2_time ASC) AS rn
    FROM q2_qualified
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    ranked.year AS year
FROM ranked
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON ranked.driver_id = d.XCL_034
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
ORDER BY ranked.year ASC

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.
Lap time recorded in the second qualifying session (Q2). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q1, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q1 times.
Lap time recorded in the third qualifying session (Q3). This column is populated only for drivers who advanced from Q2, exhibiting a strict subset relationship with Q2 times.

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

    SELECT
        r.XCL_066 AS year,
        q.XCL_058 AS driver_id,
        q.XCL_063 AS q2_time
    FROM qualifying AS q
    INNER JOIN races AS r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065

      AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2015 AND 2018
      AND q.XCL_063 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        driver_id,
        q2_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY q2_time ASC) AS rn
    FROM q2_qualified
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    ranked.year AS year
FROM ranked
INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON ranked.driver_id = d.XCL_034
WHERE ranked.rn = 1
ORDER BY ranked.year ASC

WITH RankedQualifying AS (
    SELECT 
        d.XCL_035 AS first_name,
        d.XCL_036 AS last_name,
        d.XCL_037 AS nationality,
        r.XCL_066 AS year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.XCL_066 ORDER BY q.XCL_062 ASC) AS rn
    FROM drivers d
    INNER JOIN qualifying q ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
    INNER JOIN races r ON q.XCL_057 = r.XCL_065
    WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
      AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2015 AND 2018
      AND q.XCL_062 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name,
    nationality,
    year
FROM RankedQualifying
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY year;
